questionText:

Detailed Solution:
Alfred Binet conceptualized the Uni-Factor (One-Factor) theory of intelligence, positing a single general entity of common abilities. Louis Thurstone proposed the Theory of Primary Mental Abilities, identifying seven primary factors. Howard Gardner proposed the Theory of Multiple Intelligences consisting of eight distinct types of intelligences. Charles Spearman proposed the Two-Factor Theory containing a general factor ('g') and specific factors ('s'). This corresponds to (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(I), (D)-(II).
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
